description: Figure 2 presents an ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset, specifically the left plot titled “Recall@10,” which illustrates the performance impact of removing individual components from the proposed approach. The horizontal axis lists four categorical bars labeled “Ours,” “- critiquing,” “- scoring,” and “- ranking,” representing the full model and the model with each respective component removed. The vertical axis is labeled “Recall@10” and scales linearly from 0.1 to 0.4, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The bar labeled “Ours” is orange and reaches a value of approximately 0.35. The bar labeled “- critiquing” is blue and reaches approximately 0.30. The bar labeled “- scoring” is blue and reaches approximately 0.20. The bar labeled “- ranking” is blue and reaches approximately 0.25. The bars are arranged in the order listed on the horizontal axis, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color-coding.
